currencyMismatch: This pack's currency must match the gym's currency.
taxInactive: A selected tax rate is inactive. Remove it or choose an active rate.
name: Name
expiryHelp: Leave blank for no expiry. Otherwise credits expire at gym-local midnight this many days after payment.
noPacksHelp: Use Create class pack to sell a set number of classes, such as a 10-class card.
noActivePacks: Create or restore an active class pack in the billing catalog first.
refreshHelp: Payments and refunds may take a moment to appear. Refresh credits to check again.
saleHelp: This creates an invoice. Collect payment there using the saved card, a pay link, or a cash/check payment. Credits are added when the invoice is paid.
adjustHelp: Enter 1 to 100 to add credits, or -1 to -100 to remove them. A reason is required. Credits cannot fall below zero.
invalidPack: Enter a name, a valid price, 1 to 100 credits, and optional whole expiry days from 1 to 3650.
invalidSale: Choose an active pack and a valid due date.
invalidAdjustment: Enter a nonzero whole credit change from -100 to 100 and a reason of 1 to 500 characters.
insufficient: The adjustment was refused: there are not enough available credits to remove that amount.
reused: This adjustment ID was already used for different values. Close the form and try again.
refused: The server refused this change. The pack or member may have changed. Reload and try again.
stale: This pack changed elsewhere. Close and reload, then reopen it to review the latest values before saving.
denied: You do not have access to class packs
